This '''Imperial Garrison''' was located on [[Moog Mot VI]], a [[Bank/Legends|banking]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Billal Batross]] infiltrated it to retrieve the accounting [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sollima]], but were detained by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
